reason: With the wedding coming I do want the front of the house and the hall looking fresh, but I only need some walls done, not the whole house, and ₹89,000 is more than a month of my salary for work I don't need. The coordinator and the WhatsApp photos are good for someone sitting in the Gulf, but I am not paying for the full package to get them.
objection: It is sold as a whole-house job at a fixed price. Nothing says they will do only the walls I want, and my parents would have to deal with a crew in the house for days for rooms that don't need it.
would_change_my_mind: A clear partial-job price, for example only the living room, the front exterior wall and the gate side for around ₹25,000 to ₹30,000, with the same 3-year guarantee, WhatsApp photo updates and finish date before the wedding.
